result:
All 617 existing tests pass, and the type check is clean. Summary of the fixes made:

- **Sign-out scoped to one session** (`session-repository.ts`, `session-service.ts`): added `revokeSessionByTokenHash`, and `destroySession` now deletes only that session instead of calling a sweep that deleted every session in the table (the sweep also compared `createdAt` to "now", which matched every row).
- **`purgeExpiredSessions`** now filters on `expiresAt` instead of `createdAt`.
- **"Remember me"** (`session-service.ts`, `auth-service.ts`): `createSessionToken` now takes a `rememberMe` flag — 24h without it, 30 days with it — and `login` passes `input.rememberMe` through. Registration keeps the 30-day duration it had before.
- **Reset-link TTL** (`auth-service.ts`): fixed from 60 seconds to 60 minutes.
- **Reset-link single use** (`_password-reset-repository.ts`): `findLiveResetToken` now also requires `usedAt IS NULL`, so a used-but-unexpired token can no longer be replayed.
- **New reset link retires old ones** (`_password-reset-repository.ts`): `issueResetToken` marks every previous unused token for that user as used before inserting the new one.
- **Reset completion ends all of that account's sessions** (`auth-service.ts`, `session-repository.ts`): added `revokeSessionsForUser`, called at the end of `confirmPasswordReset`.
- **Per-account rate limiting** (`rate-limit.ts`, `auth-service.ts`, `login.ts`, `reset-password.ts`): added `accountRateLimitKey()` (lowercased, trimmed email) and switched login/reset-request throttling to use it instead of a single global bucket, so one address being throttled no longer blocks any other address. Also fixed a sentinel mismatch (`ANONYMOUS_ORG_ID` now defined once in `lib/rate-limit.ts` and re-exported) so the action layer and service layer always charge the same bucket for the (address-less) reset-confirm step.
